fact_text: On 25 Nov 2025 the market stayed range-bound with low trading volumes and limited investor interest, according to the analyst.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Midday Flash | 25 Nov 2025 | PTCL, MARI, PPL, PIOC  Pakistan Stock Market Analysis' (YouTube, 2025-11-25)

fact_text: Media reports said the Telenor consumer transaction could be completed in December 2025, which the analyst said would reshape PTCL's balance sheet.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Midday Flash | 25 Nov 2025 | PTCL, MARI, PPL, PIOC  Pakistan Stock Market Analysis' (YouTube, 2025-11-25)

fact_text: Pakistan allocated offshore exploration blocks, the first offshore round since 2019, and Mari Energies received the largest share of the blocks.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Midday Flash | 25 Nov 2025 | PTCL, MARI, PPL, PIOC  Pakistan Stock Market Analysis' (YouTube, 2025-11-25)

fact_text: Pakistan Petroleum also received offshore blocks alongside Mari Energies, which the analyst said adds to Pakistan's offshore prospects.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Midday Flash | 25 Nov 2025 | PTCL, MARI, PPL, PIOC  Pakistan Stock Market Analysis' (YouTube, 2025-11-25)

fact_text: Analyst's FY26 EPS estimate for Mari of about PKR 55 to 60 implies a P/E that the analyst considered slightly overvalued rather than cheap.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Midday Flash | 25 Nov 2025 | PTCL, MARI, PPL, PIOC  Pakistan Stock Market Analysis' (YouTube, 2025-11-25)

fact_text: The analyst saw Mari's ongoing offshore drilling and Abu Dhabi Block 5 activity as the main growth drivers in the company's development.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Midday Flash | 25 Nov 2025 | PTCL, MARI, PPL, PIOC  Pakistan Stock Market Analysis' (YouTube, 2025-11-25)

fact_text: In Abu Dhabi Block 5 the operator is PPL with Mari Energies as a partner, and OGDC is also a partner in the block.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Midday Flash | 25 Nov 2025 | PTCL, MARI, PPL, PIOC  Pakistan Stock Market Analysis' (YouTube, 2025-11-25)

fact_text: Sweet gas found offshore is supplied as free-stock gas to fertilizer plants, and the ECC approved the supply arrangement for Mari gas to fertilizer plants.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Midday Flash | 25 Nov 2025 | PTCL, MARI, PPL, PIOC  Pakistan Stock Market Analysis' (YouTube, 2025-11-25)

fact_text: Mari gas goes to fertilizer plants including the old Engro base plant, the dedicated Fauji Fertilizer supply, and Fatima Fertilizer.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Midday Flash | 25 Nov 2025 | PTCL, MARI, PPL, PIOC  Pakistan Stock Market Analysis' (YouTube, 2025-11-25)

fact_text: Exploration activity at the Shewa and Spinam blocks in Waziristan has paused, and the analyst said new developments there would matter to the sector.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Midday Flash | 25 Nov 2025 | PTCL, MARI, PPL, PIOC  Pakistan Stock Market Analysis' (YouTube, 2025-11-25)

fact_text: Maple Leaf and Maple Leaf Capital already hold about 18.5% of Pioneer Cement, which the analyst said makes them front-runners for a deal.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Midday Flash | 25 Nov 2025 | PTCL, MARI, PPL, PIOC  Pakistan Stock Market Analysis' (YouTube, 2025-11-25)

fact_text: The analyst's earlier report said northern-zone cement plants at about $52 to $53 per ton of enterprise value look attractive, though not necessarily undervalued.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Midday Flash | 25 Nov 2025 | PTCL, MARI, PPL, PIOC  Pakistan Stock Market Analysis' (YouTube, 2025-11-25)

fact_text: Power Cement, a small southern-zone cement company, trades at an EV per ton of about $37, according to the analyst's report.
